Author: kaldigo
Name: Steward
Description: Collection-aware inventory decisions and market rules coordinated with the AutoRetainer integration fork. Starts in dry-run mode.
Punchline: Collect what matters. Sell the surplus.
Changelog: Group category selectors like the marketboard: Main Arm/Off Arm, Armor, Items and Housing. Combine hand/tool variants and add whole-group Select all/Clear all controls, preserving partial saved selections. Persist native glamour-plate references per character and reuse them after restart; refresh automatically from live observations, including empty plates. Label saved/live reference evidence in the UI and logs. Missing or corrupt plate caches remain unavailable and never establish collection ownership. Runtime layout and restart behavior remain subject to in-game verification.
